title: The Well-Oath of Volenfell
summary: Quell a deadly water-feud across the Alik'r oases when Kykos dust-witches and Withered Hand defilers poison the cistern-channels between Skaven, Bergama, and Volenfell.

npcs.name: Water-Judge Tarik
npcs.greet: Drink your cup dry and spill not a drop, traveller! In the Alik'r, a broken well-stone is a death sentence for three tribes.
talk: Someone shattered the bronze water-meter at Goat's Head Oasis and fouled the underground qanat feeding Bergama with graveyard salt.
Now the Crown oasis-lords of Skaven and the nomad clans of Satakalaam have drawn scimitars over the remaining wells. Ride to Goat's Head Oasis and Bergama to speak with Nomad-Matron Zulaikha.

npcs.name: Nomad-Matron Zulaikha
npcs.greet: The oasis-lords accuse my herdsmen of salting the qanat? My camels drink from the same stone troughs!
talk: My scouts tracked sandals stitched with burial-linen from Goat's Head Oasis toward Motalion Necropolis.
The Kykos Coven and corpse-binders in Motalion Necropolis are diverting the pure aquifer into the ruins of Volenfell! Speak with Sword-Brother Rami at Leki's Blade.

npcs.name: Sword-Brother Rami
npcs.greet: May Leki's edge test your resolve! We have watched dust-storms gather unnaturally over Motalion Necropolis and Volenfell for three nights.
talk: First we must slay Dust-Matron Samira in Motalion Necropolis to stop the corpse-salt from entering the aquifer.
Then we march into the Dwemer depths of Volenfell, where Conduit-Lord Kazar has locked the great subterranean cistern.

npcs.name: Ash'abah Tracker Zahra
npcs.greet: Do not fear the stained hands of the Ash'abah, stranger. Where the dead defile the living water, we walk without hesitation.
talk: Conduit-Lord Kazar is inside the central brass reservoir of Volenfell, using the stolen water-pressure to unseal a buried necropolis vault.
Strike him down and turn the Dwemer main-valve back toward Skaven and Bergama!

story_ak_goats_head_well: Nomad-Matron Zulaikha: Look at the bronze weir-gate of Goat's Head Oasis—corroded with natron-salts taken from an embalming jar!
Water-Judge Tarik: Neither Crown townsman nor desert nomad touches embalming natron. This is necromancer's work.
Nomad-Matron Zulaikha: Ride to Leki's Blade and Motalion Necropolis before every well in the hollow turns bitter!
story_ak_motalion_wellhead: Dust-Matron Samira: When the oases dry to cracked clay, the tribes will crawl to our altars for a mouthful of muddy brine!
Sword-Brother Rami: The Well-Oath of the Alik'r is sealed in steel, witch!
story_ak_volenfell_cistern: Conduit-Lord Kazar: The Dwemer built Volenfell over the deepest river in the desert—and tonight its waters belong to the dead!
Ash'abah Tracker Zahra: The water belongs to the living who walk the sands! Cut him down and open the sluice!

quests.title: The Broken Weir at Goat's Head
quests.summary: Inspect the poisoned water-channel at Goat's Head Oasis and parley with Nomad-Matron Zulaikha in Bergama.
intro: The underground qanat supplying the central Alik'r oases has been fouled with salt, bringing oasis-lords and nomad tribes to the brink of war.
Inspect the weir at Goat's Head Oasis and speak with Nomad-Matron Zulaikha in Bergama.
complete: Embalming natron on the weir-gate proved that necromancers and the Kykos Coven poisoned the water.

journal.start: Water-Judge Tarik in Skaven asked me to inspect Goat's Head Oasis and speak with Nomad-Matron Zulaikha in Bergama.
journal.done: We proved that embalming salts from Motalion Necropolis were used to foul the oasis.

Examine the natron-corroded weir with Nomad-Matron Zulaikha

quests.title: Salt of Motalion Necropolis
quests.summary: Meet Sword-Brother Rami at Leki's Blade and slay Dust-Matron Samira in Motalion Necropolis.
intro: Sword-Brother Rami at Leki's Blade has tracked the Kykos dust-witches to Motalion Necropolis, where they dump embalming salt into the qanat shafts.
Speak with Sword-Brother Rami at Leki's Blade, then enter Motalion Necropolis and defeat Dust-Matron Samira.
complete: Dust-Matron Samira was slain in Motalion Necropolis, revealing that Conduit-Lord Kazar has dammed the main aquifer inside Volenfell.

journal.start: I must meet Sword-Brother Rami at Leki's Blade and defeat Dust-Matron Samira in Motalion Necropolis.
journal.done: I slew Dust-Matron Samira and learned the main desert aquifer is dammed inside Volenfell.

quests.title: Across Sep's Spine
quests.summary: Check the ancient aqueduct markers at Sep's Spine and meet Ash'abah Tracker Zahra at Volenfell.
intro: To locate the master valve inside Volenfell, read the Dwemer pressure-markers along Sep's Spine and join Ash'abah Tracker Zahra at the entrance to Volenfell.
Visit Sep's Spine and speak with Ash'abah Tracker Zahra at Volenfell.
complete: Ash'abah Tracker Zahra deciphered the Dwemer conduit markings leading to Kazar's reservoir chamber.

journal.start: I must inspect the conduit markers at Sep's Spine and meet Ash'abah Tracker Zahra at Volenfell.
journal.done: Zahra located the master reservoir chamber inside Volenfell.

quests.title: Living Water of Volenfell
quests.summary: Storm the Dwemer reservoir of Volenfell, defeat Conduit-Lord Kazar, and report the restored waters to Water-Judge Tarik in Skaven.
intro: Deep within Volenfell, Conduit-Lord Kazar has sealed the great brass cistern that feeds the Alik'r oases.
Defeat Kazar in Volenfell, release the aquifer, and bring word to Water-Judge Tarik in Skaven.
complete: Cold, sweet water now rushes through the qanats of Skaven and Bergama, and the Crown lords and nomad matrons have renewed the Well-Oath with the Sword of the Ansei.

journal.start: I must defeat Conduit-Lord Kazar in Volenfell and report to Water-Judge Tarik in Skaven.
journal.done: I defeated Conduit-Lord Kazar, reopened the Volenfell aquifer, and received the Sword of the Ansei.
